notes: The target was pinned to CPU 0. Each semantic span includes one entry uprobe and one return uprobe, cookie-indexed nesting state, two ring records, collection, transform, and exact legacy pairing. The live stripped-binary verifier separately removed all symbols and produced 400 offset-attached spans with exact 100-root/300-child nesting. The baseline measures the same recursive calls without a collector. This is an engineering regression benchmark, not a publication-grade confidence interval.
